subject.title: fix(sessions): preserve trajectory on reset for outbound forensics (fixes #90707)

question: Should reset preserve trajectory tool-call arguments and results for the existing reset archive retention window once the cleanup compatibility bug is fixed?
rationale: The cleanup bug is mechanical, but retaining trajectory tool-call data after reset changes a sensitive-data retention boundary that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Accept retention after cleanup repair
options.body: Land the reset trajectory preservation once transcript cleanup still works for overlapping directories and tests cover the upgrade-sensitive cleanup path.

options.title: Narrow the retention policy
options.body: Require a smaller retention rule, explicit outbound/audit mode, or another maintainer-defined boundary before preserving trajectory sidecars on reset.

options.title: Reject reset trajectory retention
options.body: Keep current reset behavior and close the linked issue as not planned if the sensitive-data retention tradeoff is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept retention after cleanup repair
recommendation.body: Land the reset trajectory preservation once transcript cleanup still works for overlapping directories and tests cover the upgrade-sensitive cleanup path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history points to this person on the current session archive helper and release-forward surface touched by the PR.
